stage: Secondary descriptive training-only analysis; no model tuning or adopted question change
purpose: Check whether training gradients and feature offsets differ between SEED-IV, DEAP and GAMEEMO
models: For every fold/initialization: common initialization and selected primary single, joint, joint_heads checkpoints
data: Only original training participants; complete trial features; no validation or test examples
gradients: Disable dropout; average cross entropy equally over the two classes within each dataset; concatenate shared-backbone gradients; report pairwise cosine and gradient norms
outputs: Training recognition, shared-backbone gradient alignment and anchored feature mean offsets; no threshold adjustment or retraining
limitations: Gradient alignment is an association at selected models. Does not identify label semantics, recording quality or optimization as the causal mechanism, and does not establish a novel mitigation method.
